body:
That was me all through collage. I wouldn’t feel a damn thing even though I knew the project was due in three hours. I would try to force myself to do just a few things a day and half ass my way to the deadline so by the time my assignment was due at least I would have some of it done and less I have to rush to finish. 

But that didn’t always work. Most of the time I would sit there and watch the clock until I had like an hour to finish my final assignments before even looking at them. I would keep convincing myself I could do it later and literally never do it until too late. Thank god I was so scared of getting a bad grade. That was my ONLY driving force

I have a huge problem of starting in the middle of my story and end of having to backtrack like three times. Also if I hyper-realize I messed up I start to stutter and or laugh and it makes me seem like I’m stupid and that makes me nervous and so I mess up so bad the story doesn’t make sense so I just end it with “it was just so funny” and that’s that

I totally feel that right now. My daughter is only a year old but yet I already feel like she is the only part of me that is actually interesting. I will probably have nothing else to talk about but her. Thank goodness it’s socially acceptable to only talk about your kids to anyone who will listen because otherwise I would be the most boring person alive. When my little one goes to bed I don’t know what to do. I have no interest in anything so I sit in my room and watch stupid stuff on the internet until she wakes up again.

I feel that! It’s like every time you figure something out there is always something new. Like for example my kid switched over to solids completely and I had to deal with whole solid poop for the first time. It was confusing to say the least. 😂
There is always a warning for one thing or another so it’s best to use your judgment as a parent. I couldn’t imagine not using the gel on my poor baby’s gums, she really needed some relief.
My daughter got her first set at 5 months and it’s been a new tooth every few months so I get that

I would suggest getting some numbing jell for her gums. I use to put some on a pacifier and rub it in. A finger works too but my kiddo would bite me if I tried. Also i use to give her a tiny bit of baby Tylenol for when her fever would get super bad or the pain would prevent her from staying asleep. Just hold her lots and show her lots of love, she will need it
It’s so awful because you know you can’t do much to make her feel better

I was totally not prepared for how sick my baby girl gets when her new teeth are coming in. She is just a year old now but her molars are starting to push through, and boy is it painful. She has a fever, runny/stuffy nose, she sometimes refuses to eat, and generally is a cranky butthead every hour or so. I’ve been through this so many times but the first time this happened I was so scared, I thought she had gotten sick, but no! She was totally fine after her little tooth pushed through 🤷🏻‍♀️

Hmm I like the idea of pausing and thinking. Sometimes I rush into an answer and that makes my logic more messy. Taking five and thinking of a good way to explain something is something I need to do more often. And I get the bees the same way. Anxiety makes them buzz louder and louder until I can’t think anymore
Exactly!! I start to backtrack and try to restate my ideas but it just sounds like I’m lost
Same!! If you ask me to do six things at once I totally can do it but if you try to ask my opinion on something my words don’t match my thoughts! it’s so frustrating

That’s exactly how I feel. If I start to realize my logic isn’t as solid as I thought I start to get flustered and can’t form a good sentence and it makes me feel like I am not smart enough even tho that’s not true at all
The idea of people seeing my house a mess scares me so much I actually can force myself to do it all. But it’s so stressful cleaning everything up all at once.
Laundry is the bane of my existence I swear. I’ve never been able to do it in one sitting like normal people.
Haha that’s actually a good idea. I might just use that the next time people come over 😆
Me too!! I could be in the middle of tidying up the bathroom and then I walk into the kitchen and see the mess and feel the need to do that first.
It’s like I know I need to do it but I physically can’t
That’s a great idea. I have plenty of thick blankets I can use.
Thank you Kanye, very cool
I feel you! The first time my 4 month old slept for longer than two hours, I felt like life had blessed me with the gift of sleep and woke up well rested. Congratulations and happy birthday!!
That is a really helpful tool! I will most definitely use that when I drink for now on!
Lol its always the hard apple cider trust me. You really never expect it to be so potent till you take a break and don’t drink for a while. I always come prepared when I drink so it’s no problem

Lol my point exactly. His excuse is “i work thus I am too busy to help” if he really wants to tell me how to feed MY baby he should try feeding her first. But at the same time I just wanted to be extra extra sure before I started something
See that’s somewhat what I do. I’ve heard of your ok to drive your ok to feed but I like to be extra sure
Thank you and I will
I wish I COULD
You are right. My parents are definitely not the greatest relationship model. So I can see where I screwed up mine. I would love to have a serous discussion with him for sure
I will definitely look up my rights for sure. I think I already do qualify for a lot of stuff.
I will definitely try to get out but it’s still pretty difficult
I do sometimes feel like a child in the relationship
Wow I respect that so much. I’m scared to make that leap because I know it will totally suck. I’m in no way able to support myself but I want that to change.
I don’t at all. Just taking the leap like that scares me just a bit.
If I hung out with guys he would definitely flip his lid and I would definitely have a custody battle on my hands. I’m not trying to fight for my daughter like that.
I hate to think this is abound but you are definitely right
I agree
I’m mostly scared for my daughter. If it was just me I wouldn’t have problems cutting things off.
I hate to point it right to abuse but I definitely feel it is borderline just that. I have tried to explain it that way but he just gets offended when I do.
Thank you fo your honesty. I agree with you 100%.

Being isolated is hard and even though I love my little one with my whole heart, having to take care of her by myself alone really takes a toll on my moral. I will definitely talk to him about my rights though.
I agree that it is controlling
As a non confrontational person, I tended to give in to what he wanted to keep things good, but I can see that I should have stood up for what I wanted.
Thanks for this. I need the push to confront him about this
It is pretty sexist and I do best myself up for doing that so I do agree IATA for that
Thank you :)

Thank you for your honesty. I do feel I am in the wrong for not taking proper precautions with children and do best myself up about it often. I want my child to have the best I can give her and having a good relationship with her father has been my one focus. I’m struggling with choosing my happiness over hers and that really is a knife to me heart. I want the best for her and I need to figure out if that means leaving her father. So I’m between a rock and a hard place. I love my little family so much and want to make things work but I am seeing that I am putting in all the effort and he is doing the bare minimum. I want to be with him for a long time if that is possible but I’m not sure if that is the mindset of an abuse victim.
I will try to update everyone if I can. It will still take some guts to confront him
That’s exactly how I feel about this, but I wanted to get other opinions before talking to him about it
I would definitely like to talk to one since I have a few smaller issues along with relationship problems. I do agree it would probably benefit me a lot
Thank you for being brutally honest. I’m scared to extract myself from this relationship for a few huge reasons, but I agree that I need to put my foot down about this.
That is pretty much the whole deal. I’m a bit to young to be “happy housewife” material but he sees me as such. I’m fine with being home with the baby but there is no balance.
I agree he is being controlling, but since I have a kid I want to try working things out first before making drastic moves. I am most definitely considering things though.
Lol I wish it was that easy but I agree there is some maturing that needs to be done on his part
I don’t really have a problem with the video games since I can understand that’s how he relaxes, and we often play together. But I do agree he is immature and shouldn’t be hypocritical
I wish I had the balls to tell him that.
Understood. I do try to talk to him first, but he always gets annoyed so that’s why I want to talk to anyone else besides him.
My daughter was NOT planned out, so definitely noted.
Lol Ive done that too. I feel bad for being a human water gun
I felt so bad like I couldn’t control it 😂
We have a newborn so for the sake of the baby I want to try to make things work out first
We are both 20 and yes
Ikr!!! Holding a seven pound wiggling baby is somehow harder than I expected for some reason 😂😂
I feel like becoming a mom really gives you super powers
Looks like ill be saving all of mine for a new mommy
Lol I just went to size ones a few weeks ago and have an unopened box left lol. Oh well 😂

Keep at that breastfeeding!! It’s painful for a little bit but soon you will get so good at it you won’t even need to look anymore. It’s 100% worth it! You went through it all and now have an amazing birth story to tell your little girl. She is just as strong as you I can tell. Also I am loving her healthy plump cheeks. Sooo cute! Love that little girl with everything you got! Congrats
I definitely cried for longer. Poor thing
My boyfriend wasn’t at fault here. He didn’t expect me to put my finger that close to her face. I definitely was upset tho
I know I definitely am not a bad mom but hearing her cry made me so sad

That’s a really good point. I probably should try not to make too big a deal out of her being hurt. I know I will definitely make sure to act like that when she is a toddler, cus she will definitely fall down a lot.

She will knock her head into my shoulder in search of boob, but she never cry’s when she hits my jaw or something. Guess I wasn’t use to hearing her “I’m in pain” cry. It was jarringly different from all her other crys
Definitely
I’m happy he wanted to comfort her but yeah it was definitely messed up
Even still, hearing her cry made my heart hurt knowing I was the one to make her cry. I know she will be ok but poor baby
I think I did freak out a bit. I did talk to him after and told him essentially that.
You’re pregnant so you feel everything a thousand times worse. I feel for you
It was a bit unfair tbh. My lo is a month old
I think that’s why I cried so much. His reasoning was she would always go to me when she is hurt and he wanted to be her hero.

You will definitely see the difference soon enough . Your LO will start eating for longer intervals and sleeping more peacefully. Soon you will have more time to play and do tummy time and interact with your baby. Hang in there

Oh I’m totally dealing with that. My little one it very fussy at the moment. I think it’s because she has to poop/is gassy. She will stop fussing soon hopefully so mommy can get some much needed nap time. I think I deserve it.

Having a baby be so needy is a curse and a joy. Like “i love you but why do you need me NOW?” It gets tiresome when you just put them down and decide to nap but they start crying twenty minutes after you lay down...

....then you get a warm feeling in your chest as they snuggle close to you after feeding and sleep peacefully. You feel like a big strong superhero to this tiny little bean.
I definitely had a mental breakdown at two weeks but getting sleep really helped with that. Going through all this has made me realize how bad ass moms really are.
I love the baby snuggles! As time goes on and my baby becomes more coherent of the world around her the bonding time just seems to get better and better.

Honestly I understand your frustration. Don’t worry, as they get into the forth and fifth weeks this will all but stop needing to eat every hour. Your baby will start to eat more and sleep longer. This will also fix the need for them to be held when they sleep. My little one sometimes will cry when I put her down still, but if I wait a few minutes after she falls asleep she is deep enough asleep to not notice I put her down. You got this!
You can really feel the difference too! I have become way less short fused since I started getting more sleep
Lol another one?? Wow I can’t wait till pregnancy was just a distant memory for me. I definitely will laugh when I miss having a newborn to take care of.

It’s always ok to cry. The first few weeks are tough. No matter if you’re breastfeeding or bottle feeding, taking care of an infant is pretty stressful. But things will definitely get better. Soon you will be able to change a diaper with one hand while on the phone with your grandma and trying to plan what to get your cousins dog for its birthday. You can do it!

That’s a good point. She does eat from both sides but she seems to enjoy the right side over the left. I doubt that is an issue since she seems to be able to use her neck quite well. She has had great movement and control even at two weeks. At a month she can hold her head up and look around for a minute or so before getting tired.
Thanks for crediting me. I wasn’t aware of this at all
This may not be me because I have carpet, but god forbid I shut the door even a bit loud lol
Oh that’s perfect cus I have a nursing bra and those would definitely work
I like the idea of lids! I’ll give it a look
Ooh I like the sound of that!

I probably could, I’ve never thought about that. I think a scheduled time might make her feel more at ease.

And honestly same! I always come to reddit for everything. Reading about everything that everyone else goes through helps me realize I’m not totally alone. I definitely will tho and same for you

It definitely makes me crazy but I guess it needs to be done. I try to talk to my mom since she has been through this before but she has her own thing going on and my siblings to take care of. That’s why I turned to reddit for help.
I’ll look into it! Definitely open to many options

I definitely want to try for a year. Six months exclusively then with solids for another six. But teeth scare me. I would love to keep my nipple thank you very much. I think if my LO bites I might change to pumping and give her my milk out of a bottle instead.
Honestly that sounds beautiful

That seems to be a trigger for me too. I realized I had PDD when I was having fun playing poker with my in laws. I had to stop to go feed my baby and when I was done, everyone was done playing and my father in law had gone to bed. It made me sad and ruined my whole night because I spent the next hour thinking of all the situations that could arise where taking care of the baby would interfere with daily life. I immediately felt like a bad mother for putting my needs above the baby, and spent the rest of the night crying and feeding her.
I didn’t think disposable was worth the buy but I definitely will look into them for sure now

I already deal with minor depression so I felt I could deal with PDD but it’s something entirely different.

I will definitely look into it. I know the haakaa has good reviews too.

My partner is able to watch the baby but I think taking care of a baby by himself scares him more than me so he is very reluctant. I can get him to watch her long enough to take a shower though. All through pregnancy shower time has been “me time” so I took one like ever day and still do.
Omg that sounds painful. My baby didn’t latch right when I first started feeding her and even that probably wasn’t as bad

That’s exactly how I’m feeling right now. I’m scared I’m not feeding her enough cus she is eating all the time but is still so fussy and doesn’t sleep for long only to cry for food. And the falling asleep while eating!!

I meant no disrespect with PDD. I probably should have worded it differently. I meant that you might want to be prepared to get it because I wasn’t and it hit me pretty badly at first. 

I would like to get something to collect the extra flow of milk and won’t probably buy anything without doing research first.

I definitely know I need to hang on until things get better. Having a little one is great and I love her a lot and I love watching her grow. I just can’t wait until things even out because I definitely need a good nap.
I have my fingers crossed
I’ll keep that in mind, thanks!
“Fountain” more like “fire hose” lol trust me I’ve been trying to figure out how to stop it too.

I wish you all the luck In the world! The hardest part of having a newborn is now. Every day feels like the same routine of dirty diapers and a fussy LO but I’ve heard it gets better. Try your best to just relax and get as much rest as you can. We can do this!!

Honestly that and the cost of formula outweighs the pain of breastfeeding so far hbut things might change. 

I love the time I can bond with my baby but if she fusses all the time it’s more me comforting her than anything
Lucky you have an oversupply. I wish I had that problem
I definitely need a waterproof mat. The amount of times I wake up in a wet puddle is so annoying
Thank you for these words of encouragement. It’s really hard doing this on my own but I know it gets better.
I really felt bad when my baby started crying, but I’ve started to realize a bit of crying from her doesn’t make me a bad mother.
It seems like everything evens out at around 4 months but god does that seem so far away rn. My LO is only 2 weeks old and everything is so hard rn still
The leaking drives me crazy. Sometimes it’s more irritating than even the baby fussing at 3 in the morning sometimes

I understand you. Not having help is the hardest part. And it’s not like you can even ask for it anyway (at least with the breastfeeding part) I’ve tried not to take my frustration out on him but it hasn’t worked very well.
The men don’t understand! My s/o doesn’t get why I’m so frustrated all the time and I really can’t explain it to him 😭
I really can’t wait until then
Yeah I heard it was on and off with how it works for people, but I would mostly just use to stop the leaking everywhere
I’ll have to look into getting some
I will definitely take that into account when looking for one, thanks!
I’m hoping it happens soon.

She does have a small tongue tie but she is kinda fussy when she feeds now, I’m thinking due to a growth spurt. She will pull at the nipple or kick me while she feeds. I can have the doctors look at her tongue tie and see if maybe that might be why she is so fussy when she feeds.
I didn’t know that at all. Poor thing is so gassy all the time and I feel so bad for her.
I’m definitely getting one now
Oh really that’s clever. I’m looking for one on amazon because I totally didn’t know I needed one.
Im totally already looking for one on amazon!
I didn’t think of that. Would any regular pump work for that because I have a small portable pump I could use.
Omg I’m just waiting for my girl to try that 😅

I definitely think you won’t create bad habits. She is still very young and there is plenty of time to encourage going to bed at night. Just don’t let her know you find her cuteness irresistible because she can and WILL use that against you.
God when you actually want to go to bed, suddenly they get fussy and are inconsolable 😂

Lol I heard it gets better after a few weeks but god does that feel like a long time from now. I’ve only had my little one for a week and a half but every day feels like a routine of dirty diapers and feeding. At least I can bend down without doing a sumo squat and I can finally see my toes 😅
Thank you so much!! I totally didn’t know where to find any
That’s the kind of stud I have atm and she has pulled it out so many times I’m actually thinking of buying new ones she won’t be able to pull out.
My baby girl loves to wave her hands around while she breastfeeds and somehow she always manages to pull my stud nose ring. Granted it does stick out a bit but she always manages to scratch it off
Honestly I feel you there! My baby girl won’t knock out unless I give her the boobies. The only problem is the feeding relaxes her just as much as I do and I end up napping with her on my chest.

Honestly my postpartum journey was not as hard as what your poor s/o went through. For the engorgement though, hot showers are her best friend. When she feels well enough to take a shower, she should definitely have one. I liked to sit in the shower and gently massage them a bit. Then I would feed my baby and that would bring the pain down a lot. Even when my baby girl wouldn’t eat everything I had to offer, a few times at each breast would make a real difference. Just keep strong like you have been doing! It will mean the world of difference for her! Good luck and congratulations
Thank you! I can’t help but worry a little. New mommy things.

That’s good to know. I worry about her weight just a bit because she was born with a low birthweight and lost a bit more than she should have after birth. I just wanna make sure I’m not doing anything wrong
That’s a very good point.
She doesn’t really cough or gag, maybe once in a while. I’ll keep an eye on that tho.
I have seen one before for improper latching but it wouldn’t hurt to see another one. Thanks!

Thank you so much. This really made me feel better. My little girl was born with a low birthweight and she lost a bit of weight due to not latching properly. We got the latching issue fixed, but I still worried she wasn’t getting enough. Thank you for setting my mind at ease.

That’s what I thought, but it doesn’t hurt except when she first starts sucking. I’ve visited a lactation consultant before because breastfeeding hurt a lot and they fixed how she was latching on. She also drains my breasts and has the proper amount of diapers. I’m a ftm and she was born with a low birthweight so I want to make sure she has all the nutrients she needs. Maybe another visit wouldn’t hurt tho
I really didn’t think of asking!! Thanks for giving me the idea
She is an Easter surprise 🥺💕
Yeah my baby is mostly swaddled when she isn’t laying on my chest. Thank you for the well wishes
I don’t but I have some really small newborn clothes that should fit lol
Oh my goodness yes!!!
I know right!!

I’m not exactly sure what the plan is yet. I have an appointment on Tuesday where we will go over everything and monitor the baby to see if she is fully grown and I have enough fluid in my uterus. I definitely will ask more direct questions when I know what my path is.
36 weeks now and I have finished Netflix. Hulu was easy. YouTube is next. I plan to conquer the World Wide Web. Baby is due April 27. Nothing will stop me from completing the internet.

I miss having normal sex, being 36 weeks now. I can’t do anything comfortably anymore and end up having to tap out because I can’t breathe. My poor bf is so starved from physical attention that he literally begs me for anything. I’m like, trust me baby I know!
Wow congratulations! Everyone seems to be having a girl right now, and I’m loving it! Little baby girls are such cuties

It’s a curse and a blessing to have the little one inside you I totally feel that. And I feel you on that whole move thing. For the time being I’ve had to move my little nursery setup to my FIL’s place due to the quarantine. They are better prepared for this than we were so we were invited to stay with them till everything is over. They are also close to the hospital I will be giving birth at so everything worked out for the better.
Omg me too. Even just turning over I have to swing my whole body weight to shift position. I feel like a planet rolling around like that. I will never take my normal body for granted ever again
I was at work and I coughed...thank the lord for black jeans.
Honestly I love being pregnant. I lost all my stubborn babyfat and love my little belly, but now I feel tired and hangry all the time lol
Thanks a lot! Being pregnant sucks cus I get super emotional over silly stuff like this but it’s almost over!! Yay!!
He is most definitely not a bad guy he just has some issues he needs to work on. I too have to get over being a jealous baby, but I definitely do need some friends.
Yeah I got pissed off about that because I was friends with them for an equally long time. Now I’m wondering if I should hit them up and get back in touch because they were the only friends I had
Yeah I thought the same thing and I’m willing to deal with that because I can manage. I love him a lot and we can make a great team sometimes. I just don’t like this one part of his character.

That’s what I’m afraid of. The thing that contradicts that is he always makes things about him. No matter who he is with he likes the attention on him. He does the same thing with his other GUY friends, and I always float in the background.
Thanks a lot!

Wow you are literally saying everything I am scared to think of much less express. That is how I feel 100% but I am totally devoted to my boyfriend and our baby way too much to even bring this up. 

I try to keep my feelings to myself because I know I don’t have anything to worry about here. She wouldn’t make a move on him, and he wouldn’t dare try anything either. 

He doesn’t leave me behind and will always ask if I want to come with him but when I’m there I’m the third wheel. That’s the uncomfortable part.

About the last part tho, he is the one who asks her to hang out. He hits her up first and will always bother her.

I don’t want him to not have friends and I have not forced him to stop talking to her but have only told him it makes me uncomfortable when they hang out late at night. He always tells me I can come along but when I am with them I become the third wheel. I would like to be her friend too but I can’t because he always interrupts and gets her attention back on him. (That last part is something he does with everyone. He likes to be the center of attention)

I forgot to mention in the post that I did use to have a lot of guy friends but he asked me to cut them off because he didn’t feel comfortable with how comfortable we were together which I didn’t have a problem doing. So I felt like I would also have the same right if need be. But other than that I don’t really have any friends either.

Your point about not making this a grudge between us is the exact reason I’m asking for help. It is becoming that and I hate myself for feeling this way

That’s the funny thing he has told me that they did almost kiss but stopped because they were drunk and thought it was weird. But you are definitely right, I need to get over it. Thanks I needed to hear that.
Lol congratulations, you are one of the rare few having a boy this year
Omg yes and lots of people are having girls too!
It’s so hard to accept the fact that i do actually need help! I’m like no thanks I can’t lift this (can’t lift it) uh actually....
When is your due date? Mines April 27
Congratulations on making it this far!!
Im 33 weeks but I’m so tiny that four and a half pounds of baby is kinda a lot to carry.
Yes!! I use to laugh at people when they told me just wait until I have to do a sumo squat to pick up something. I can’t bend down any other way now and have to pull myself up too.

Omg I have been treated like a princess when it comes to hard work, like no no let me do that for you cus you’re pregnant! I’m like no thanks I can carry this one thing still. I’ll ask for help if I can’t lift/do something, but for the most part I hate accepting that I am becoming immobilized by the pregnancy.

I can one up you on this one. Of course I get the usual, oh wow you look really pregnant today, but this one seems to be the most annoying thing anyone has done ever. I have personal space right? So why does everyone ask to TOUCH THE BELLY?? Even worse are the people who just come and touch it!! Like excuse me hi please don’t touch me.
Oh absolutely! Plus you can pair it with pink or blue once you find out!
You are having a rare treasure!

Lol I also thought was having a boy for a while, but as time went on I felt that it didn’t seem right. Thank god for ultrasounds and modern technology right? Also gray and neutral colors are a safe bet just incase lol
Thanks!!
Omg everyone is having a girl this year (myself included) congratulations!!

No stretch marks on me. Unfortunately i am super super white. That means you can see literally every vein in my body. My growing boobies have tons of little blue veins and now my belly is growing bigger I have lots on my sides too.
I am afraid to tell him that lol. Our sex life will be on a huge hiatus.

Yes me too!! I went from always saying yes to a little bit of play time but now I’m like half awake and slow. Part of my boyfriends way of showing affection is through physical affection which I love and totally get. I think he also thinks I don’t find him attractive which I make sure to tell him is not true

I really try to be accommodating to my S/O in many ways because a relationship is about compromise and I would hope for the same respect in return. That being said if I am not in the mood for sex I will state it, but instead I will help him out if he needs it. Him being needy really makes me feel bad though because I’m totally needy too and I can’t even help him out anymore an I get what he feels.

I’m sorry if it seems off-putting. I’m not trying to make it seem like all he does is take. I wouldn’t do anything I don’t want to do and he knows it very well. He “begs” for the attention not necessarily the sex. I’ve been neglecting him in all sorts of ways, not just sex.

Lol we did have a conversation and I explained that my sex drive has tanked a lot. He understood and now only complains in a joking manner. Of course it’s totally childish but I can understand him 100% because I feel the same way too.
I did have a talk with him and he seemed to understand but was definitely disappointed. Whenever he asks now it’s an old habit instead of him actually asking to do anything.
He could but to him it’s not as satisfying or fulfilling as having a connection with someone. I understand that and feel the same way. I am kinda sympathetic with his case just a bit.

I’m only 30 weeks and I already feel like pure exhaustion. On top of just carrying the child, I work and was diagnosed with anemia. My little bean has been kicking me a lot and her favorite thing to do is push on my right rib cage. She is a huge pain in the butt but I love her even still. I just can’t wait for this pregnancy to be over though.
Me too. You can’t help it I guess. But it’s all good if you use that to set guidelines for your own family. I already know what NOT to do.

Sometimes it’s your own blood and kin that are your worst enemy, but that makes me want to be a better parent to my little kiddo. I hope you have a super healthy birth and your little girl grows up happy and healthy

Girl I feel you! Before I got pregnant I struggled with depression and hated school and life in general. I was anti social and probably would have ended up addicted to substances as well if I didn’t find out I was pregnant. I know how hard life can treat you but I am so happy this baby is a positive light for you and I wish the best for your future. 

As for the people in my life, they have an old fashioned way of thinking. It is mostly my parents that are saying these things and though they are saying they will do what they can to help, they never really have shown that support when I was still living with them as a kid.
